notes.title: Update notes for Version 1.1
notes.content:
Version 1.1 has been released with some changes to improve gameplay and Quality of Life.

[list]
[*] Interaction Boxes Should now show the correct input based on if playing with a controller or not
[*] Added an icon to show when you are holding a plank
[*] A text box has been added displaying how to change the Journal pages
[*] Journal pages can now be turned with the Z and C keys
[*] Journal pages are no longer random and now in a set order, with priority to the most confusing monsters
[*] Removed flying tree at the start (you will be missed)
[*] Planks now move around randomly after being caught
[*] Added new spawn locations for the planks
[*] Updated Terrain textures (this is an ongoing issue and is still being looked into) 
[/list]

[b]If you find any other bugs, please report them on Steam or Social Media Platforms.[/b]

Thank you for playing Peril in the Pines
